dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong*

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『はい』
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉だけど」
dialogues.en: "I, it's Asakura."
dialogues.text: "I, it's Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ、はい、ちょっと待って下さいね』
dialogues.en: "Ah, okay, please wait a second."
dialogues.text: "Ah, okay, please wait a second."

dialogues.jp:
ガチャリと受話器が下ろされる音。続いて、ド
アが開いた。
dialogues.en:
I heard the receiver put down, and shortly after, the door
opened.
dialogues.text:
I heard the receiver put down, and shortly after, the door
opened.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Welcome!"
dialogues.text: "Welcome!"

dialogues.jp: ドアの隙間から覗いた顔が、にっこりと笑った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori peeped through a crack in the door, her ever-sweet
smile showing.
dialogues.text:
Kotori peeped through a crack in the door, her ever-sweet
smile showing.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「入って入って」
dialogues.en: "Come in, come in!"
dialogues.text: "Come in, come in!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お邪魔します」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.jp:
ドアをくぐる。ぱたぱたと、何故か小走りに、
ことりの背中が遠ざかる。
dialogues.en:
As I started to enter, I could hear Kotori running, and I
went in in time to see Kotori's back disappear into a room.
dialogues.text:
As I started to enter, I could hear Kotori running, and I
went in in time to see Kotori's back disappear into a room.

dialogues.jp: 「……ん？　いいのかな、入って……」
dialogues.en: "...Mm? Is it really all right if I come in..."
dialogues.text: "...Mm? Is it really all right if I come in..."

dialogues.jp:
靴を脱ぎ掛けたまま迷っていると、ことりは居
間に通じるドアから顔だけをにょきりと出して。
dialogues.en: As I left my shoes at the door,
dialogues.text: As I left my shoes at the door,

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、早く早く」
dialogues.en: "Come on, hurry up!"
dialogues.text: "Come on, hurry up!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、こっちです」
dialogues.en: "Over here."
dialogues.text: "Over here."

dialogues.jp: 鬼さんこちら、ですか？
dialogues.en: Are we playing hide and seek or something?
dialogues.text: Are we playing hide and seek or something?

dialogues.jp: （何で、隠れるようにするんだろう？）
dialogues.en: "(Why's she hiding herself all the way?)"
dialogues.text: "(Why's she hiding herself all the way?)"

dialogues.jp:
まるで、妖精かあやかしの類に、どこかへ連れ
て行かれようとしているような……。
dialogues.en:
It's a bit like chasing a little fairy all over the
place....
dialogues.text:
It's a bit like chasing a little fairy all over the
place....

dialogues.jp:
彼女がそこに居たと思った次の瞬間には、別の
場所に瞬間移動してしまっているような……。
dialogues.en:
Whenever I reach where she last was, she'd appear in a new
location...
dialogues.text:
Whenever I reach where she last was, she'd appear in a new
location...

dialogues.jp:
そんな、奇妙な｛めいてい／酩酊｝感を起こさせるようなシチュ
エーション。
dialogues.en:
I eventually snapped myself out of thinking of that silly
situation.
dialogues.text:
I eventually snapped myself out of thinking of that silly
situation.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こっちですよ」
dialogues.en: "Here, here!"
dialogues.text: "Here, here!"

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺は、ドアの前に｛たど／辿｝り着いた。“こと
り”という表札が掛かっている。
dialogues.en:
I finally ended up in front of a door. On it's front, the
nameplate "Kotori" was hung.
dialogues.text:
I finally ended up in front of a door. On it's front, the
nameplate "Kotori" was hung.

dialogues.jp: こんこん。
dialogues.en: --*knock knock*
dialogues.text: --*knock knock*

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞー」
dialogues.en: "Come in~"
dialogues.text: "Come in~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……もう、ベッドにスタンバってますか」
dialogues.en: "Uu... I need to stand by the bed now..."
dialogues.text: "Uu... I need to stand by the bed now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何をスタンバるんですか……」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean, stand by..."
dialogues.text: "What do you mean, stand by..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「病人さんなんだから、寝るのは当たり前じゃ
　ないですか」
dialogues.en: "Patients would of course be resting in bed, no?"
dialogues.text: "Patients would of course be resting in bed, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ほんとに病人か？　エライ元気そうじゃ
　ねえか……」
dialogues.en:
"...Are you really a patient? You seem awfully cheerful for
one."
dialogues.text:
"...Are you really a patient? You seem awfully cheerful for
one."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんな事ないですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "T, that's not true~"
dialogues.text: "T, that's not true~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごほっ、えほっ……うう、持病のしゃっくり
　が……」
dialogues.en:
"Cough, cough! Uuu, my chronic disease is causing me to
cough..."
dialogues.text:
"Cough, cough! Uuu, my chronic disease is causing me to
cough..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……それを言うなら、持病の｛しゃく／癪｝じゃないの
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"...Aren't people with chronic diseases supposed to go into
spasms once in a while?"
dialogues.text:
"...Aren't people with chronic diseases supposed to go into
spasms once in a while?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そ、そうでしたっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? I, is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? I, is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、良くなったんなら何よりだけど」
dialogues.en: "...Well, it's better if you don't know."
dialogues.text: "...Well, it's better if you don't know."

dialogues.jp:
拍子抜けしたような感じで、デスクの前にある
椅子に勝手に掛けさせてもらう。
dialogues.en:
With a disappointed look, I took a seat on a chair near her
desk.
dialogues.text:
With a disappointed look, I took a seat on a chair near her
desk.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「てへへ……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Eheheh... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Eheheh... I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ悪びれた感じで、ことりは目を伏せた。
dialogues.en: With a bit more calmness, Kotori looked down.
dialogues.text: With a bit more calmness, Kotori looked down.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ほんとは、もう看病なんて必要ないくら
　い快復したんです」
dialogues.en:
"...Actually, I don't really need someone to look after me
to recovery now."
dialogues.text:
"...Actually, I don't really need someone to look after me
to recovery now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、あれから、お姉ちゃんがお義兄さんを
　呼んでくれたから」
dialogues.en: "Yesterday, my sister called brother to take a look at me."
dialogues.text: "Yesterday, my sister called brother to take a look at me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……？　兄さんが来たから、何だって？　と
　いうか、３人兄妹だったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...? Your brother? You mean you have two other siblings?"
dialogues.text: "...? Your brother? You mean you have two other siblings?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、えと、お姉ちゃんのフィアンセさんで
　す。お医者さんなんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, umm, I meant my sister's fiancee. He's a doctor."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, umm, I meant my sister's fiancee. He's a doctor."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、なるほどな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私、目が覚めたの夜中だったんです。けど、
　お姉ちゃんたら、無理矢理呼んで……」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't wake up till nighttime, so my sister called him
while I was unconcious..."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't wake up till nighttime, so my sister called him
while I was unconcious..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ災難だったな。お義兄さんにしたら」
dialogues.en: "Poor him."
dialogues.text: "Poor him."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、嫌な顔ひとつしないで来てくれました。
　ほんと、いい人を見つけたと思います」
dialogues.en:
"But he came with nary a word of unhappiness. I really think
he's a good person."
dialogues.text:
"But he came with nary a word of unhappiness. I really think
he's a good person."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.jp:
何だか意外かも。暦先生って、恋愛沙汰とかに
は｛うと／疎｝そうな印象があるからな……。
dialogues.en:
That's pretty surprising. I would've expected Koyomi-sensei
to keep her romance affairs out of everyone else's
affairs...
dialogues.text:
That's pretty surprising. I would've expected Koyomi-sensei
to keep her romance affairs out of everyone else's
affairs...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああいう人との結婚なら、私は祝福しちゃい
　ますね」
dialogues.en:
"I'd gladly give my blessing to that kind of person to marry
my sister."
dialogues.text:
"I'd gladly give my blessing to that kind of person to marry
my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「駄目人間相手なら？」
dialogues.en: "What about those wholly incapable types?"
dialogues.text: "What about those wholly incapable types?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「大事なお姉ちゃんを、そんなとこにはやれま
　せん。絶対反対ですね」
dialogues.en:
"I won't let my precious sister be married to that kind.
Never ever."
dialogues.text:
"I won't let my precious sister be married to that kind.
Never ever."

dialogues.jp: くすっと笑う。まるで父親のような言い草。
dialogues.en: She giggled a little. She sounded like a father saying that.
dialogues.text: She giggled a little. She sounded like a father saying that.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、俺は絶対反対だな」
dialogues.en: "Then never ever for me, apparently."
dialogues.text: "Then never ever for me, apparently."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、え〜。朝倉君とお姉ちゃんですか？」
dialogues.en: "E, ehh~? You and my sister?"
dialogues.text: "E, ehh~? You and my sister?"

dialogues.jp:
目を丸くしたことりに、冗談だけど、と首を振
る。
dialogues.en:
I rolled my eyes at Kotori, silently telling her that it was
a joke.
dialogues.text:
I rolled my eyes at Kotori, silently telling her that it was
a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……もし朝倉君が相手なら、別の意味で、身
　体を張ってでも反対しますけど」
dialogues.en:
"...If she were to start dating you, I would be opposed to
it, but not for that reason."
dialogues.text:
"...If she were to start dating you, I would be opposed to
it, but not for that reason."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふ。何でもない♪」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, nevermind.♪"
dialogues.text: "Hehe, nevermind.♪"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んん？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
何故か赤い顔をして唇を尖らせている。熱でも
あるのか？
dialogues.en: Her face had gotten as red as her lips. Was she feeling hot?
dialogues.text: Her face had gotten as red as her lips. Was she feeling hot?

dialogues.en: "...Are you feeling warm?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you feeling warm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「暑くないし、熱もないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Not warm, nor hot."
dialogues.text: "Not warm, nor hot."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ……そういやさっき、どうして隠れるよ
　うにしてたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... anyway about earlier, why were you hiding all the
way here?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... anyway about earlier, why were you hiding all the
way here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だって……」
dialogues.en: "B, because..."
dialogues.text: "B, because..."

dialogues.jp: 再び赤い顔。
dialogues.en: Her face turned red again.
dialogues.text: Her face turned red again.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「パジャマ姿なんて、恥ずかしいじゃないです
　か……」
dialogues.en: "It's embarassing to let you see me in my pajamas..."
dialogues.text: "It's embarassing to let you see me in my pajamas..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……何固まってるんです？　わ、やだ、変な
　想像しないでくださいよ……」
dialogues.en:
"...W, why are you so silent? ...Wah, don't, don't start
imagining weird things..."
dialogues.text:
"...W, why are you so silent? ...Wah, don't, don't start
imagining weird things..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……変、かどうかは分からんけど、健全な男
　の子には当たり前の想像……だと思うんだが」
dialogues.en:
"...I won't say it's anything weird, it's just things a
normal, healthy young man would think of..."
dialogues.text:
"...I won't say it's anything weird, it's just things a
normal, healthy young man would think of..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、ま、減るもんじゃなし」
dialogues.en: "W, well, it's nothing much anyway."
dialogues.text: "W, well, it's nothing much anyway."

dialogues.jp: ごほんと咳払いしてから、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I cleared my throught and continued talking.
dialogues.text: I cleared my throught and continued talking.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、その様子なら、１５日の卒パには間に
　合いそうだな」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, seeing how well you're doing now, you should be
able to prepare in time for the graduation party."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, seeing how well you're doing now, you should be
able to prepare in time for the graduation party."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。今日、明日くらい休めば、完璧
　さんです。痛い注射の甲斐がありました」
dialogues.en:
"I think so too. If today and tomorrow, I rest fully, it
should be completely gone. I took an injection as well."
dialogues.text:
"I think so too. If today and tomorrow, I rest fully, it
should be completely gone. I took an injection as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、練習不足になっちゃったのが、不安で
　すけどね……」
dialogues.en: "But I'm still worried we may not have practiced enough..."
dialogues.text: "But I'm still worried we may not have practiced enough..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いやあ、ことりなら、もう今でも充分なくら
　いだろ」
dialogues.en: "Nah, as you are now, you're plenty good enough."
dialogues.text: "Nah, as you are now, you're plenty good enough."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな事ないですよ」
dialogues.en: "That's not true..."
dialogues.text: "That's not true..."

dialogues.jp:
苦笑気味にてへへと笑った。あるいは、照れ隠
しかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She laughed a little at my admission. Probably hiding her
own embarassment.
dialogues.text:
She laughed a little at my admission. Probably hiding her
own embarassment.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、まあ、マジで良かったよ。ほんとに」
dialogues.en: "But really, thank goodness you're alright now."
dialogues.text: "But really, thank goodness you're alright now."

dialogues.jp:
椅子の上でぐっと伸びをする。何だか、肩の荷
が下りた感じ。
dialogues.en:
I stood up from the chair and stretched. It felt like a load
had been lifted off my shoulders.
dialogues.text:
I stood up from the chair and stretched. It felt like a load
had been lifted off my shoulders.

dialogues.jp: 「一時は、どうなる事かと思ったからな……」
dialogues.en: "You had me worried for awhile..."
dialogues.text: "You had me worried for awhile..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「心配かけて、ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "Sorry about that."
dialogues.text: "Sorry about that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "It's okay..."
dialogues.text: "It's okay..."

dialogues.jp:
心配──それは、ことりの身体の事ばかりじゃ
なかった。
dialogues.en: I wasn't just worried about Kotori's state though.
dialogues.text: I wasn't just worried about Kotori's state though.

dialogues.jp:
卒業パーティーの行く末。あの３人が、悔いの
ない演奏が出来るのかどうかを……。
dialogues.en:
I was worried for the graduation party as well. I want the
three of them to do their best at their performance, and
leave with no regrets...
dialogues.text:
I was worried for the graduation party as well. I want the
three of them to do their best at their performance, and
leave with no regrets...

dialogues.jp: 「良くなったんだから、何も言うことはない」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad enough that you're okay, no need to say anything."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad enough that you're okay, no need to say anything."

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりとかぶりを振る。いつの間にか、入れ
込んでいてしまったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I shook my head calmly. She's always been putting all her
effort into everything she's done, she deserved some rest.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head calmly. She's always been putting all her
effort into everything she's done, she deserved some rest.

dialogues.jp:
口から出まかせのマネージャー。けれど、その
役割も知らないままに、心だけはそうなってい
た。
dialogues.en:
What came out of my mouth were the words of a manager. But
the duties that didn't befit one, the ones that I held in my
heart...
dialogues.text:
What came out of my mouth were the words of a manager. But
the duties that didn't befit one, the ones that I held in my
heart...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私のこと、心配してくれました？」
dialogues.en: "Weren't you worried about me?"
dialogues.text: "Weren't you worried about me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ、もちろんだけど？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that obvious?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that obvious?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「マネージャーさんだから？　それだけの、理
　由ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Because you're my manager? Was that the reason?"
dialogues.text: "Because you're my manager? Was that the reason?"

dialogues.jp:
潤んだ瞳。それに、赤い顔。やっぱり、熱でも
あるんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Dim eyes. And a red face. Maybe she really is getting hot?
dialogues.text: Dim eyes. And a red face. Maybe she really is getting hot?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……いいですよ」
dialogues.en: "...It's okay."
dialogues.text: "...It's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "What is?"
dialogues.text: "What is?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「おでことおでこ、コツンってやりましょう　
　か？」
dialogues.en: "To do the forehead-to-forehead test?"
dialogues.text: "To do the forehead-to-forehead test?"

dialogues.jp:
いつ見られたんだろう？　ちらつく疑問符に目
が回りそうになりながらも、ことりの顔から目
が離せない。
dialogues.en:
When did she see that? I averted my eyes as I tried to think
of when I let that slip, but her gaze never left.
dialogues.text:
When did she see that? I averted my eyes as I tried to think
of when I let that slip, but her gaze never left.

dialogues.jp:
マネージャーだから──だけでは、たぶん、な
かった。
dialogues.en: As a manager-- I guess that was mostly it...?
dialogues.text: As a manager-- I guess that was mostly it...?

dialogues.jp:
「……でも、看病はいらないくらいに、体調は
　快復したんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"...But you said that even without someone looking after
you, you would recover quickly anyway, right?"
dialogues.text:
"...But you said that even without someone looking after
you, you would recover quickly anyway, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「…………？　だったら、どうして俺を呼んだ
　んだ？」
dialogues.en:
"......? So why did you even call me here in the first
place?"
dialogues.text:
"......? So why did you even call me here in the first
place?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……決まってるじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "...Isn't it obvious..."
dialogues.text: "...Isn't it obvious..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君と一緒に居たかったからですよ……」
dialogues.en: "I wanted to be near you..."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to be near you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱ、熱あるみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "...You really must be feeling hot."
dialogues.text: "...You really must be feeling hot."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「試してみますか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like to find out for sure?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like to find out for sure?"

dialogues.jp: すっと身体を起こす。
dialogues.en: She raised her body slightly from her bed.
dialogues.text: She raised her body slightly from her bed.

dialogues.jp:
熱が、移ったみたいだ。全身に、焼け付くよう
な｛ほて／火照｝りを感じている。
dialogues.en:
The heat definitely got around. It seemed like her entire
body was aglow with heat.
dialogues.text:
The heat definitely got around. It seemed like her entire
body was aglow with heat.

dialogues.jp: 両足に力を込め、立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: Putting all my power into my legs, I stood up.
dialogues.text: Putting all my power into my legs, I stood up.

dialogues.jp: こんこん。
dialogues.en: --*knock knock*
dialogues.text: --*knock knock*

dialogues.en: Wha!?
dialogues.text: Wha!?

dialogues.jp:
どだだんっ！　まるで磁石のように、尻が椅子
に引き寄せられた。
dialogues.en: Bang!! Like a magnet, my butt slammed back into the chair.
dialogues.text: Bang!! Like a magnet, my butt slammed back into the chair.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「やほ〜、ことり。ああ、玄関の靴は、やっぱ
　り朝倉だったか」
dialogues.en:
"Heya~ Kotori. Ahh, the shoes at the entrance just now must
be Asakura's."
dialogues.text:
"Heya~ Kotori. Ahh, the shoes at the entrance just now must
be Asakura's."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……どうもです」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 絡みつきそうな舌で、何とかそれだけ口にする。
dialogues.en:
My tongue was so twisted, I didn't even know what I was
saying anymore.
dialogues.text:
My tongue was so twisted, I didn't even know what I was
saying anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、今さっきの音、何？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, what was that sound just now?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, what was that sound just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: （み、見られてないよな……？）
dialogues.en: "(S, she didn't see anything...?)"
dialogues.text: "(S, she didn't see anything...?)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　どしたん、朝倉。青い顔して。もしか
　して、風邪移った？」
dialogues.en:
"Mm? Oy, Asakura. Your face is turning blue. Don't tell me
you're catching Kotori's cold?"
dialogues.text:
"Mm? Oy, Asakura. Your face is turning blue. Don't tell me
you're catching Kotori's cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？　あいやいや、滅相もない」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah no no! that would be absurd!!"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah no no! that would be absurd!!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……何なのよ、その答えは」
dialogues.en: "...What's with that reply?"
dialogues.text: "...What's with that reply?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「んもう、仕方ないな。ほら、でこ貸してみ」
dialogues.en:
"Whatever, I better check anyway. Here, lend me your
forehead."
dialogues.text:
"Whatever, I better check anyway. Here, lend me your
forehead."

dialogues.jp:
さくさくと歩み寄ると、ぐっと顔を突き出して
くる。
dialogues.en:
She walked calmly towards me, then suddenly our faces were
centimetres apart.
dialogues.text:
She walked calmly towards me, then suddenly our faces were
centimetres apart.

dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、あの……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah, um..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah, um..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、お姉ちゃん。朝倉君に、それはな
　いんじゃない？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute, sis! You can't just do that to him!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute, sis! You can't just do that to him!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　ああ、それもそうだった。悪い悪い、
　つい昔の癖で……」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Ah! Sorry sorry, I forgot... old habits die hard..."
dialogues.text: "Hm? Ah! Sorry sorry, I forgot... old habits die hard..."

dialogues.jp: ぽりぽりと頭を｛か／掻｝くと、すまんと呟いた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi nervously scratched her head, and muttered an
apology.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi nervously scratched her head, and muttered an
apology.

dialogues.jp: 「パチキでもかまされるかと思いましたよ」
dialogues.en: "I almost had a heart attack."
dialogues.text: "I almost had a heart attack."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何であたしが、んな事しなきゃいけないのよ」
dialogues.en: "Psh, it's just me."
dialogues.text: "Psh, it's just me."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「でも、昔の癖って何です？」
dialogues.en: "But what do you mean by old habits?"
dialogues.text: "But what do you mean by old habits?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君と同じだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's the same as you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "It's the same as you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりに目を向けると、彼女は、自分の額をこ
つこつ叩いた。
dialogues.en:
I switched my gaze to Kotori, who was wrinkling her
forehead.
dialogues.text:
I switched my gaze to Kotori, who was wrinkling her
forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私ね、昔はしょっちゅう風邪とか引いてたの。
　そんな時に……」
dialogues.en:
"When I was young, I was always catching colds and stuff
like that. When that happened..."
dialogues.text:
"When I was young, I was always catching colds and stuff
like that. When that happened..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、おでことおでこを」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, forehead-to-forehead."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, forehead-to-forehead."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「懐かしいよねえ。あの頃のことりは、ほんっ
　とに、可愛かったなあ……」
dialogues.en:
"That makes me feel nostalgic. At that time, Kotori was
really so cute..."
dialogues.text:
"That makes me feel nostalgic. At that time, Kotori was
really so cute..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……まるで、今は違うみたいだね」
dialogues.en: "...And now it's completely different, huh?"
dialogues.text: "...And now it's completely different, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「さあ？　一緒にお風呂に入らなくなってから
　は、ことりのことは良く分かんないなあ」
dialogues.en:
"Really? I haven't bathed with you for so long, I can't
really tell accurately anymore."
dialogues.text:
"Really? I haven't bathed with you for so long, I can't
really tell accurately anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Geez..."
dialogues.text: "Geez..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: （一緒に風呂……ですか）
dialogues.en: "(Bathed together...huh.)"
dialogues.text: "(Bathed together...huh.)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「わわわっ！　こりゃ大変！　顔が真っ赤だ。
　熱がぶり返したかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Wawawa! What's happening now? Your face is red as a tomato!
Did the hotness return?"
dialogues.text:
"Wawawa! What's happening now? Your face is red as a tomato!
Did the hotness return?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、朝倉、あんたはもう、帰った帰った！」
dialogues.en: "Come on Asakura, you better go home quick!"
dialogues.text: "Come on Asakura, you better go home quick!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え？　で、でも……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? B, but..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? B, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほぅら！　ぐずぐずしないっ！」
dialogues.en: "Come now! Don't be so slow!"
dialogues.text: "Come now! Don't be so slow!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……俺、何しに来たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...Why did I come in the first place?"
dialogues.text: "...Why did I come in the first place?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの看病１◆
dialogues.en: ◆Looking After Kotori 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆Looking After Kotori 1◆

dialogues.jp: 約束通り、ことりの家へとお見舞いに行った。
dialogues.en: Fufilling my promise, I went to Kotori's house to visit her.
dialogues.text: Fufilling my promise, I went to Kotori's house to visit her.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、暦先生の婚約者──お医者さんらし
い──に診てもらったおかげで、もう良くなっ
ているようだった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was examined by Koyomi's fiance--a doctor-- so she
was looking much better than I expected.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was examined by Koyomi's fiance--a doctor-- so she
was looking much better than I expected.

dialogues.jp: ほっとしたような、拍子抜けのような気分。
dialogues.en: I felt a bit relieved and disappointed at the same time.
dialogues.text: I felt a bit relieved and disappointed at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
そして、あれこれと喋っている内にいい雰囲気
になったところで──暦先生が現れたのだった。
dialogues.en:
And then the atmosphere got weird after a bit of
talking--but Koyomi-sensei's entrance changed everything.
dialogues.text:
And then the atmosphere got weird after a bit of
talking--but Koyomi-sensei's entrance changed everything.
